title: Audible Listen Session Minutes Listened Leaderboard
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=audible:listen minutes_listened=*
| stats sum(minutes_listened) as total_value, avg(minutes_listened) as avg_value by book_title
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks book title values by total and average minutes listened across Audible listen session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `minutes_listened` values for each Audible listen session event and review total and average minutes listened by book title.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total minutes listened.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which book title shows the biggest minutes listened numbers in your Audible listen session data.
